snippet.title: BEERCRUSH LAUNCH TRAILER
snippet.description:
Available NOW!! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3912370/BEERCRUSH/

- 8+ frantic, procedurally generated worlds to chug beer in!
- 10+ Bottlecaps, equip these to gain new abilities ranging from a shield of beer to a shotgun!
- 3 Gamemodes, each providing a unique take on John Beer's adventure, and a unique ending!
- Unlockable Borders to customize your experience!
- A rockin' original soundtrack, perfect for getting your stomach pumped
- There is also beer.

SO WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR!? LIVE LIFE! EVERY GOLDEN MINUTE OF IT!!

#indie #indiegame #roguelike #beer
